integrated_multimodal_description: Claymation plasticine stop-motion, handcrafted modelling clay with visible fingerprints and matte finish, photographed on a miniature practical set. a small military vehicle-wash bay of riveted grey steel plates. Wet grey concrete floor, two faded yellow safety lines, one rectangular drain hole at centre with the grate lying face down beside it, red-wheel water valves and a coiled hose reel on the left wall, electric cabinets and a broom on the right wall, two stacked steel drums at rear right, a white canvas curtain on a ceiling rail at the back, a bare chain with a hook above the drain, two caged industrial lamps. Cool hard overhead light, short shadows, wet surfaces. TEO (frame left): tall thin white clay man, huge straw-blond walrus moustache, teal knitted beanie with cream stripes, red-and-black checked flannel shirt, brown suspenders, khaki trousers, dark boots. JUCA (frame right): short wide Black clay man, burnt-brown flat cap, mustard cable-knit sweater, olive-green trousers, pale wooden clogs, pencil behind the right ear. Exactly two clay puppets appear in the frame: TEO stays at frame left and JUCA stays at frame right; no other people or animals appear. All transitions between shots are INSTANT HARD CUTS on the exact cut timestamps: no cross-dissolve, no fade, no double exposure, no translucent ghost figures, no duplicated characters, no morphing between poses. AT START: phone box torn off the wall and lying on the fallen grate; receiver still in TEO's hand on the cord; the bay empty behind the curtain. [Shot 1] the opening tight two-shot held exactly from the previous shot: TEO at frame left holds the cream telephone receiver at his ear with the coiled cord running down to the phone box lying face down on the floor beside the fallen steel grate; JUCA at frame right keeps one hand on the bucket cart; both hold their positions for a beat, breathing. The wet concrete floor keeps its shallow puddles throughout the whole clip. [Shot 2] At 00:01.200, the camera cuts to a close insert of the floor: JUCA's hands lift the galvanized bucket off the bucket cart and set it down upright on the wet concrete beside the drain - the bucket stays planted there and never moves again for the rest of the shot; then the black casters of the now-empty cart roll into frame and the front caster rides straight OVER the cream phone box lying face down by the drain, flattening and cracking the case under the wheel, and the cart keeps rolling. There is EXACTLY ONE galvanized bucket on the cart, ONE steel drum moving and ONE steel grate in this frame - no duplicate object ever appears, no second bucket and no second telephone. [Shot 3] At 00:04.500, the camera cuts to a wide shot: the empty cart tips over on its side with the flattened phone box pinned under it; the steel drum rolls off the cart bed, runs across the loose steel grate lying beside the drain, and the grate settles flat on top of the rolling drum; the galvanized bucket stays planted upright beside the open drain; TEO straightens up and points at the hole a beat too late. There is EXACTLY ONE galvanized bucket on the cart, ONE steel drum moving and ONE steel grate in this frame - no duplicate object ever appears, no second bucket and no second telephone. [Shot 4] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to a wide shot: the drum rolls to the right wall and stops there with the steel grate balanced flat on top; the galvanized bucket still sits planted upright beside the open drain; the crushed phone box juts out from under the toppled cart; and JUCA puts both hands on his knees and follows the drum with his head. There is EXACTLY ONE galvanized bucket on the cart, ONE steel drum moving and ONE steel grate in this frame - no duplicate object ever appears, no second bucket and no second telephone. They do not speak and their mouths do not move, but they breathe, swallow and react with their whole bodies. AT END: empty steel drum at rest against the right wall with the steel grate balanced flat on top; the galvanized bucket planted upright beside the open drain; client gone; crushed phone box pinned under the toppled cart.
overall_soundscape: A military boot taps twice on wet concrete, then the dolly caster scrapes over the bakelite phone box and the hollow steel drum rolls away with a low rumble. TEO makes one short nasal snort. JUCA clicks his tongue once.
